title: Can You Retake the Canadian Citizenship Test?
excerpt: Yes. If you don't pass, IRCC will usually invite you to take it again.
description: Can you retake the Canadian citizenship test if you fail? Here's what usually happens next and how to make sure you pass the second time.
body:
Yes. If you don't pass the Canadian citizenship test, IRCC will usually invite you to take it again. If you don't pass after that, you may be asked to an interview with a citizenship official.

## The pass mark

The test has 20 questions and you need 15 correct to pass. Missing just 6 questions means a fail, so it's worth preparing well.

## Before your next attempt

- Think about which topics felt hardest: government, history or geography
- Re-read those chapters of Discover Canada
- Practise questions by topic until you get them right every time
- Take full mock tests and aim for 17 or more out of 20

## Don't forget your province

Questions can cover your own province or territory, so make sure you know its key facts.

Check the IRCC website for current rules. Take a free mock test below to see where you stand.
